eligibility: Self-service is for paid orders before shipment handoff. Unpaid, partially handed-off, and shipped orders use existing support or returns.
scope: This release cancels a whole order only.
authorization: Only the authenticated order owner can self-cancel. Support keeps its existing channel and permissions.
handoff: The click means cancellation requested. Cancellation requires fulfillment confirmation. If handoff wins, record the decline and route to returns.
duplicate: Repeat submissions show the existing outcome and do not create a second cancellation or refund.
refund_amount: A confirmed cancellation starts the existing asynchronous refund of the full captured amount to the original payment method.
refund_deadline: No fixed refund deadline is promised.
customer_visibility: Order history shows requested, canceled, unable to cancel, and the refund status.
support_visibility: Support sees the final outcome and failure reason.
email: No new email notification in this release.
release: Use the existing order history and support views. Bulk operations and additional channels are out of scope.
